text.tspan: Measures 25–28: One-bar repeating motive — the sequential motion accelerates.
Learn each bar as a cell, then 25–26 and 27–28, and finally 25–28 without stopping.
Measures 29–31: Metric reorientation with an implied syncopated bass voice.
Practice as one three-measure unit; also reduce the passage to the important bass notes before restoring all sixteenths.
Measures 32–35: Displaced slur groups and descending sequential motion.
Use overlapping groups 32–33, 33–34, and 34–35 so the slurred pattern is not tied mechanically to the barline.
Measures 35–42: Four two-measure descending sequential units with implied upper and lower voices.
Practice 35–36, 37–38, 39–40, and 41–42; measure 35 intentionally overlaps the preceding section.
